# Ideas Pages

This is the home page of project ideas of the Example Umbrella for Google Summer of Code 2026.
Since Example Umbrella is an umbrella organization you will only find links to the ideas
page of each member project here.

- [Alpha Lab](https://github.com/alpha-lab/alpha/wiki/GSoC-2026-Projects)
- [Beta Toolkit](https://github.com/beta-toolkit/beta/wiki/GSoC-2026-project-ideas)
- [Gamma Solver](https://gamma-solver.ai/dev/#google_summer_of_code)
- [Delta Stats](https://github.com/delta-stats/delta/wiki/GSOC-2026-Proposed-Projects)
- [Epsilon Viz](https://github.com/epsilon-viz/gsoc/blob/main/2026/ideas-list.md)
